description: An ordinary nested query receives original words without an inherited close constraint (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(candidate)
%conditions matches(without-elision($x), rival)
%rule candidate X [+T]
%rule rival $y(body)
%conditions matches($y, raw), ¬matches($y, bare)
%rule body X [+T]
%rule raw X [+U]
%rule bare X T
